audience: sales operations teams that manage deals and payouts in QuotaPath

useCases.title: Find the deals of one owner
useCases.text: List the deals filtered by the owner's email, then read one deal with its values and state.

useCases.title: Sync resolved payouts to other systems
useCases.text: List the resolved payouts, or only those changed since a Unix time in seconds, to send them to other systems.

useCases.title: Choose the right compensation path for a deal
useCases.text: List the compensation plans with their paths, and the users and teams in the workspace. Path ids go into deal values.

useCases.title: Add a closed deal to a path
useCases.text: Create a deal with its owner, amounts per path and state. Confirm the owner, path ids and amounts first, because this changes commission data.

useCases.title: Correct or remove a deal
useCases.text: Update some fields of one deal, or delete it. A deleted deal cannot be restored through this server.
